qualification_provenance: Two parts. (1) Emulated: a 30-minute campaign on macOS arm64, run on 2026-11-25 in a separate worktree checked out at the tag commit (the engine qualification in that worktree recorded an empty patch shortly before), through the service operation that oxfuzz kernel and the desktop app call (ServiceContainer::run_syzkaller_observed_with_environment), driven by the live test live_syzkaller_boots_executes_programs_and_records_the_campaign. (2) KVM: two 30-minute campaigns through the same operation on hosted GitHub ubuntu-24.04 x86_64 runners with /dev/kvm on 2026-11-24, on a development branch whose result was merged to main as d63cab37, an ancestor of the tag; they were not rerun on the tag commit.

approval: None requested: the test constructs the service without an approval handler. An operator run goes through the oxfuzz kernel approval.
limitations: The KVM campaigns ran before the tag on a development branch and were not repeated on the tag commit.
The one KVM crash report (SYZFAIL: posix_spawnp failed) was not reproduced and its cause was not investigated; that campaign predates the crash-count fix, so its summary recorded 0 crashes.
Throughput is not qualified; the emulated run executes about one program per second.
No kernel crash occurred in the emulated run; kernel crash reproduction and complete symbolization are not qualified.
Kernel, rootfs and private guest keys are not distributed with the application or website.
The oxfuzz kernel command line, a supplied manager.cfg, the desktop app's launch path, Stop and resume, and more than one guest were not exercised.
candidate_delta: Emulated part: none known (same worktree as the engine qualification, which recorded an empty patch). KVM part: the tag adds the crash-count fix, the native-Linux build-script fix, the Windows CI removal and the 0.9.11 version bump on top of d63cab37.
